column1: No one here seems willing to acknowledge your presence. Maybe they're not too fond of humanoids.
column2: 這裡沒有人願意搭理你。看來他們不太喜歡人形生物。

column1: The only thing you hear when attempting to eavesdrop is "Eat felch, humanoid!"
column2: 你想偷聽，結果只聽到一句：「去吃屎啦，人形生物！」

column1: That act, while providing a means of venting frustration, serves only to cause you considerable pain when your toes scatter in directions they weren't designed to travel. Wise up, Space Cadet!
column2: 這樣做雖然能發洩一下情緒，你的腳趾卻會因此往奇怪的方向亂折，痛得要命。放聰明點，太空菜鳥！

column1: It's not advisable to be trying anything aggressive here since you are out-numbered.
column2: 這裡人多勢眾，最好別想耍狠。

column1: There are no surfaces on which to place your posterior other than the floor and you don`t want to do that.
column2: 這裡除了地板，沒有別的地方能放你的屁股——但你應該不會想坐地板吧。

column1: Wine? Did I say we have wine? Hey did you hear this humanoid? He wants wine! Get serious!
column2: 「酒？我有說我們有酒嗎？嘿，你們聽到這個人形生物說什麼了嗎？他想喝酒耶！別鬧了！」

column1: Whatever you say.
On the stage is one of the hottest bands in the quadrant.
column2: 舞台上是這個象限裡最紅的樂團之一。

column1: Sorry, the machine is currently out of order. Please come again.
column2: 抱歉，這台機器目前故障中。請下次再來。

column1: Gulp! Gulp!
You have one of those coupons, huh? Here's your 5 buckazoids and your free beer. Enjoy.
column2: 「你有那種折價券喔？來，這是你的5枚太空幣和免費啤酒，慢用。」

column1: Just walk up close to the machine to play.
You don't have enough buckazoids.
You have made a relatively decent purchase of a pre-owned sale item.
column2: 你買下了一件還算划算的二手特價品。

column1: That model is ideal for flight systems operations. It will pilot any modern fighter or cruiser. And, it is one of the most experienced droids we carry. I ask only 45 buckazoids for it (36 with coupon).
column2: 「那款很適合用在飛行系統操作，能駕駛任何現代戰機或巡航艦。而且，它是我們這裡經驗最豐富的機器人之一。我只要45枚太空幣（有折價券的話36枚）。」

column1: I got it from some gambling type who was required to pay-up or perish.
column2: 「我是從一個賭徒手上弄來的，他不付錢就得死。」

column1: That unit is a good, all-around droid. Sure, it may seem a little dinged-up but it's not as bad as it looks. There is still quite a bit of life left in it. It is a great little companion. And for you, only 40 buckazoids (32 with coupon).
column2: 「那個型號是很不錯的全能機器人。沒錯，它看起來有點傷痕累累，但沒你想的那麼糟，還很耐用。它是很棒的小夥伴。給你嘛，只要40枚太空幣（有折價券32枚）。」

column1: We call that one The Peacemaker. It's used primarily in security. In a crime situation it is capable of apprehending, trying, sentencing, and punishing the offender on the spot. Swift and effective. And only 368 buckazoids (294 with coupon).
column2: 「我們叫它『和平使者』。主要用在保安工作。碰到犯罪現場，它能當場逮捕、審判、判刑，還執行懲罰。又快又有效率。只要368枚太空幣（有折價券294枚）。」

column1: That compact unit is often used for mining. It is short and stocky, and quite strong for its size. It is designed to work in areas which may be hazardous to non-mechanized beings. 325 buckazoids for years of service (294 with coupon).
column2: 「那款小型機器人常用在採礦。個子矮壯，力氣卻不小。專門設計來在對非機械生命體有危險的地方工作。325枚太空幣就能用上好幾年（有折價券294枚）。」

column1: That one is a collector's item. One of the very first droids ever built. Someday that rare piece is going to bring me a small fortune at auction. It's not for sale.
column2: 「那台是收藏品，是最早期造出來的機器人之一。總有一天，這件稀世珍寶會在拍賣會上讓我大賺一筆。它不賣。」

column1: Welcome to Droids-B-Us, the finest emporium for mechanized beings in the quadrant. We have a complete line of droids for any purpose imaginable. Well, almost any.
column2: 「歡迎光臨機器人量販店，本象限最頂級的機械生命體專賣店。我們有齊全的機器人系列，任何你想得到的用途都找得到。嗯，幾乎啦。」

column1: All top-of-the-line, but, I suppose YOU would probably be interested in our SALE items. Please walk this way."
column2: 全都是頂級貨，不過，我猜你大概只對我們的特價品有興趣。這邊請。

column1: Only one droid per person in this town. It's an ordinance, you know.
column2: 「這城裡規定一人只能買一台機器人。這是法令，你知道的。」

column1: Nice to see you again. Where is your little friend?
column2: 「很高興再見到你。你的小夥伴呢？」

column1: Oh, I do hope nothing has happened to it. Especially with it being a sale item. You did understand that sale items aren't covered under the terms of our warranty policy, I'm sure.
column2: 「喔，希望它沒出什麼事，尤其它還是特價品。你應該知道特價品不在我們的保固範圍內吧。」

column1: I'll be upstairs if you need anything.
This is the inside of Droids-B-Us. The room has a pedestal in the middle and a stairway and balcony toward the back. A variety of droids adorn the floor space.
column2: 這裡是機器人量販店的內部。房間中央有個基座，後方是一道樓梯和陽台。地板上擺滿了各式各樣的機器人。

column1: There is nothing I can tell you that the salesman hasn't already.
column2: 銷售員該說的都說過了，我沒什麼好補充的。

column1: The salesman is a strangely built being. He looks like he might tip forward any minute.
column2: 這個銷售員的體型很奇怪，看起來隨時都會往前倒。

column1: Silly human!
You cannot see anything out the tiny and unimportant window.
column2: 這扇窗又小又不起眼，你什麼都看不到。

column1: Why?
There is nothing special about the rail and, no, you can't slide down it.
column2: 這扶手沒什麼特別的，而且不行，你不能滑下去。

column1: The banner indicates that there is a sale occurring.
column2: 布條上寫著現在有特價活動。

column1: There is no need to do that.
Not for sale.
Using your discount coupon you have made a relatively decent purchase of a pre-owned sale item.
column2: 用你的折價券，你買下了一件還算划算的二手特價品。

column1: I see you bear one of those coupons. Oh, well. You shall receive 20\\% off any of my quoted prices.
column2: 「我看你身上帶著那種折價券。好吧，我開的所有報價都算你打20\\%的折扣。」

column1: That item is not in your possession.
Are you here to talk or are you here to buy, the salesman asks.
column2: 「你是來聊天，還是來買東西的？」銷售員問道。

column1: You have this strange sinking feeling.
column2: 你有種說不出的不祥預感。

column1: Ken? Did you hear something?

Through a strange quirk of fate (or was it?) you have stumbled into a place beyond time, space and dimension. You have entered...The Daventry Zone!! That's right, the land of King's Quest. This will not help you now since you are playing Space Quest.
column2: 由於命運的奇特安排（還是說並非如此？），你誤打誤撞闖進了一個超越時間、空間與次元的地方。你進入了……戴文垂領域！！沒錯，就是《國王密使》的世界。不過這對你沒什麼幫助，因為你玩的是《宇宙傳奇》。

column1: It was probably just the gators entertaining another Space Quest player. Go back to sleep, 'berta.
column2: 那大概只是鱷魚又在耍另一個玩《宇宙傳奇》的玩家吧。回去睡覺啦，柏塔。

column1: Despite your surprisingly valiant effort, you have been blown to eternity by the Star Generator itself.
column2: 儘管你出乎意料地英勇奮戰，最後還是被星辰產生器本身炸得灰飛煙滅。

column1: As you nervously hang on, the skimmer rises slowly to the surface of the planet via a secret passage.
column2: 你緊張地抓緊扶手，沙漠飛車沿著一條秘密通道緩緩升上星球表面。

column1: Upon reaching the surface, you throttle up and zoom off into the sunset.
column2: 一到地面，你立刻加足馬力，朝著夕陽疾駛而去。

column1: There seems to be sand as far as the eye can see.
column2: 放眼望去似乎全是沙子。

column1: There is not much to see. Just a lot of sand.
column2: 沒什麼好看的，只有一堆沙子。

column2: 你身處沙漠中。北邊有一座平頂山。

column1: You hear a strange roar, like something traveling through the atmosphere at a very high rate of speed.
column2: 你聽到一陣奇怪的咆哮聲，像是有什麼東西正以極高速穿越大氣層。

column2: 一陣警報聲把你嚇了一跳，接著傳來一個急促的聲音，警告阿寇達號已遭不明入侵者登艦——話才說到一半就戛然而止。
